blurb: Duck Creek Golf Club offers a golf course with mature trees and scenic views, designed by Michael Hurdzan. Guests can play daily fee rounds, join annual or player development memberships, and use practice facilities including a driving range, putting green, and short game area. The club also hosts golf events with professional consultation and customizable packages.
